entries.4696dba3f85a6d34: As its group management philosophy, it cites “We connect people and food with smiles, and we are a corporate group that is always trusted,” and as its medium- to long-term aspiration it has formulated “Group Vision 2036.” It states that it aims to be a group that continues to grow as a pioneer of temperature-controlled logistics and supports rich living through a logistics network spanning Japan and Asia. As the first step toward this, it formulated the 8th Medium-Term Management Plan covering the four years from the fiscal year ended November 2025 to the fiscal year ending November 2028, and under the theme “Ensuring the sustainability of logistics and creating new value,” it is pursuing three basic policies: “Developing domestic operations,” “Expanding new areas and further exploring them,” and “Strengthening the management foundation.” For the final year of the medium-term plan, the fiscal year ending November 2028, it aims for operating revenue of ¥210 billion.
